D020-D013_h001.question: It’s been a tough few months since the divorce, doctor. I just… I can’t seem to get a handle on things. I’m constantly on edge, just a ball of nerves really. My mind races with worries, mostly about finances and how I’ll manage everything alone. I feel this constant jitteriness, like I've had too much coffee, even when I haven't touched a drop. Sometimes, when my ex comes to pick up the kids, I feel this intense panic, a desperate urge to stop them from leaving, even though I know they’ll be back. It’s silly, I know. I just can’t shake this feeling of being overwhelmed and incredibly sad, like a gray cloud has settled over me and won't lift. It’s hard to concentrate at work; my clients deserve better than my scatterbrained self. I used to love planning trips, but now even that feels like a monumental effort.
D020-D013_h001.options:
A. Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)
    B. Adjustment Disorder
    C. Major Depressive Disorder
    D. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation)

D020-D013_h002.question: "Thanks for seeing me, doctor. Honestly, I'm not sure where to start. It's like a dull ache, constantly there, for the past month or two.
